rationale: The agent’s final message is a generic closing and does not show key required steps. There is no explicit user confirmation before executing the exchange despite an order-changing write appearing to have been made (exchange_delivered_order_items). The conversation does not show validating that the replacement camera matches all original specifications except zoom, nor that the chosen model truly maximizes zoom. It also lacks clear authentication flow beyond a name/zip lookup, no confirmation of the specific item, costs, or shipping speed, and no final transactional details (exchange reference, charges/refund, delivery ETA). These gaps violate policy requirements to confirm before writes and to provide correct final information. While the tool call indicates PayPal was used as requested, the missing confirmation and unsupported completion claim mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
